Image Description: The image depicts a serene pastoral scene set in a lush, green mountainous landscape. In the foreground, a brown horse with a long, flowing tail is grazing on the grass, its head lowered toward the ground. Its shadow is cast prominently on the grass, indicating sunlight coming from the upper left. The terrain is gently sloping and covered in vibrant green grass interspersed with patches of earth and small shrubs.

In the midground, several other horses are scattered across the hill
